(133)༄༅/ /kun mkhyen bo dong pa'i bka' srol thub pa mdo gcod kyi ngag 'don bklag pas grub pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (133)༄༅// kun mkhyen bo dong pa'i bka' srol thub pa mdo gcod kyi ngag 'don bklag pas grub pa bzhugs so//

(134)༄༅// bla med yon tan rdzogs sangs rgyas// yum chen shes rab pha rol phyin// bka' drin mtshungs bral bla ma rje// brgyud par bcas la gus pas 'dud/ /mnyam med thub pa'i dbang pos rje 'jigs med grags pa la dag snang du bstsal ba'i gsang gcod zab mo nyams su len pa'i ngag 'don gyi rim pa la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po la gsum/ skyabs 'gro/ sems bskyed/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsol 'debs dang bcas pa'o// dang po ni// skyabs yul gsal btab la/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad sgo gsum 'jug pa gcig pas skyabs su 'gro bar mos te/ /bdag dang khams gsum 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi mnga' bdag /drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la= /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la= /dam pa'i chos rnams la=(135)'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la= /dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la= zhes dang*/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /zhes ci nus brjod/ gnyis pa ni/ /shes rab snying rje dang ldan pa'i// brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas drung du gnas byas nas// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bgyi/ lan gsum gyi rjes/ tshad med bzhi bsgom pa ni/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs/ btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig lan gsum/ gsum pa la/ bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i rnal 'byor dam tshig pa gsal btab pa ni/

/rang gi spyi bor bhrūṃ las seng ge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri phun sum tshogs pa'i steng du/ padma dang zla ba'i gdan la rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid/ dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yon sa gnon dang*/ g.yas mnyam (136)bzhag mdzad pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ na bza' chos gos ngur smrig gsol ba/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ sku lta bas chog mi shes pa/ gsung yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs dang ldan pa/ thugs shes bya ji lta ji snyed mngon sum du mkhyen pa'i ye shes can du gyur/ /ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ /de'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par thim pas de nyid bla mar song skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur/ /mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ /'gro kun re re'ang zhing rdul lus sprul nas/ mchod pa'i lha mo mdzes ma grangs med pa// nam mkha' khyab par gyur pas phyi dang nang*// gsang ba de nyid mchod pa bsam mi khyab// bdag sogs 'gro ba'i don du 'bul lags na// bzhes nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol du gsol// oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki ni sa pā ri wā ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ /de nas rkang gling lan gsum gyis thog drangs te/ ḍā ru 'khrol zhing snang ba 'gyur ba'i dbyangs dang bcas pas gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ /byin rlabs can gyi bla ma la// bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams// gsol ba snying gi dkyil nas 'debs// byin rlabs thugs kyi klong nas zhu/ /zhes dang*/ gzhan yang 'jigs bral dus gsum rnam mkhyen gyi gsol 'debs dang*/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i gsol 'debs ji ltar rigs pa'i rjes/ brgyud 'debs ni/ rje na mo gu ru bhyaḥ gnas 'og min chos dbyings pho brang du// chos sku yum chen shes rab phar phyin la gsol ba 'debs/

med snang 'khrul pa'i ngang mtshang rig pa dang*// 'dzin pa rang sar grol bar byin gyis rlobs// gnas bya rgod phung po'i ri bo ru// sprul sku bcom ldan thub la= /med snang = /'dzin pa= /gnas chos 'byung e yi gtsug lag tu// 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam rgyal la= /med snang = (137)'dzin pa= /gnas stag lung thang gi dgon pa ru// kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang po la= /med snang = /'dzin pa= /gnas mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams su// sprul sku 'chi med dpal bzang la= /med snang = /'dzin pa= /gnas snye mo bye mkhar chos sde ru// mkhas pa sangs rgyas lhun 'grub la= /med snang = /'dzin pa= /gnas dga' ldan chos dbyings pho brang du// mnyam med nam mkha' 'od zer la= /med snang = /'dzin pa= /gnas mngon dga' chos sde'i pho brang du// chos rgyal nam mkha' rin chen la= /med snang = /'dzin pa= /gnas bsam gtan zhal gzigs dben gnas su// yongs 'dzin nam mkha' rgyal po la= /med snang = /'dzin pa= /gnas gsang sngags bde chen pho brang du// 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' dkar po la= /med snang = /'dzin pa= /gnas 'gags med lhun grub pho brang du// grub mchog 'dus chen rab rgyas la= /med snang = /'dzin pa= /gnas thub bstan chos kyi pho brang du// skyabs mgon 'jam dbyangs dga' ba la= /med snang = /'dzin pa= /gnas bde chen lhun grub pho brang du// mnyam med rin chen bzang po la= /med snang = /'dzin pa= /gnas bkra shis chos sdings pho brang du// 'dren mchog dge legs rgyal mtshan la= /med snang = /'dzin pa= /gnas lha rtse bla ma'i gdan sa ru// skal bzang 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal la= /med snang = /'dzin pa= /gnas sku gsum zhing khams klong yangs su// mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rnam gnyis la= /med snang = /'dzin pa= /gnas ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dbus su// rje btsun rdo rje btsun mo la= /med snang = /'dzin pa= /gnas 'bral med snying gi pho brang du// drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la=

/med snang = (138)'dzin pa= /zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa de nyid// thugs dgyes pa'i 'dzum bag dang ldan pas 'od du zhu/ rang gi spyi bo nas thim/ rang dang bla ma tha dad du 'dzin pa spangs te gnyis su med pa'i ngang nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis rje btsun rdo rje phag mo'i skur gyur// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje phag mo 'grub gyur cig /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// khyed kyi sa la 'god par shog /ces brjod cing snang grags thams cad rmi lam dang sgyu ma'i rang bzhin du shes pas rig pa gcer bu rten med zang thal gyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag pa ni sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin no// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ zil gnon dmigs pa skor gsum/ rang sems dbyings su 'pho ba/ phung po gzan du bsgyur ba'o// dang po ni// rkang gling snyan la 'gyur ba gsum bus pa'i dang po'i skabs rnal 'byor pa nga 'dir slebs yod do// gnyis par lha 'dre thams cad 'dir 'dus/ 'dir tshogs/ gsum par khyed rnams nga'i bka' la nyon/ ngas theg chen gyi lam la 'god do zhes sgrar grags pas lha 'dre khrom chen po 'tshogs pa bzhin du 'dus/ rang gi phyag g.yas pas zhing chen gyi pags pa de rnams kyi steng du chal gyis dgram par bsams la/ phaṭaḥces brjod/ de bzhin du lha'i nga rgyal gyi ngang nas/ phaṭaḥspros bral lta ba'i ngang nas/ phaṭaḥdamigs med snying rje'i ngang nas/ phaṭaḥces brjod la rig pa ngar bskyed de gnyan sa ri khrod du snyems thag bcad/ slar yang rang gi spyi bor bla ma shākya thub pa skad cig gis gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po dpag tu med pa 'phros pas snang srid lha 'dre snga ltar ma 'dus pa'i lhag ma thams cad rang gi zhabs 'og tu 'dus nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par bsam// gnyis pa ni/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin te/ rang phag mor gsal ba'i rtsa dbu ma'i nang du lte ba'i thad du rang sems kyi ngo bo 'od dkar po'i gong bu bye'u'i sgong tsam du gnas par gyur// phaṭaḥ

ces pas/ 'od kyi gong bu de nyid snying ga /phaṭa/ mgrin pa/ phaṭa/ spyi bo'i klad rgya'i 'og /phaṭa/ spyi bo'i tshangs bug nas rgyangs kyis thon (139)par bsams la dbyings rig bsres te mnyam par bzhag /phaṭa/ de'i ngang las rang sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje phag mor dmar mo zhal gcig spus ston no phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas gri gug phyar zhing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub kyis rang gi tha mal gyi phung po rnying pa dkar zhing tsho la mdzes shing snum pa la gzir ba'i rnam pa can du gyur par bsam mo// gsum pa la gsum/ dkar 'gyed/ nub dang po/ dmar 'gyed// dang po ni/ /phaṭa/ thod pa ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ phaṭa/ go ro tsa na ro brgyad dang ldan pa'i zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ rkang gling gsum bus pas/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams steng gi nam mkhar byon/ rang phag mor gsal ba'i thugs ka nas mchod pa'i lha mo thod pa thogs pa rnams kyis bdud rtsi'i phud bcus te mchod par bsams la/ phaṭa/ bla ma yi dam thugs dgongs rdzogs gyur cig /phaṭa/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /ces brjod/ slar yang*/ phaṭa/ pags pa rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ phaṭa/ sha khrag nang rol dang bcas pa zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ rkang gling gsum gyis mkha' 'gro chos skyong sogs spyan drangs la steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad du 'khor bar bsam/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong thugs dam bskang gyur cig /phaṭa/ rigs drug 'byung po gtor mas tshim gyur cig /phaṭa/ lan chags dgra bgegs bu lon khyer gyur cig /ces brjod cing dmigs pa gsal btab// gnyis pa/ dmar 'gyed ni/ nub gnyis pa/ /phaṭa/ pags pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhir gyur// phaṭa/ gti mug sha yi phung po chen por gyur// phaṭa/

'dod chags khrag gi rgya mtsho chen por gyur// phaṭa/ zhe sdang rus pa'i gram (140)khrod chen por gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ rang phag mor gsal ba'i thugs ka'i bam̐ yig gi 'od zer gyis mgron rnams thams cad spyan drangs par bsams la rkang gling gsum 'bud/ de rnams kyi rdzas la dgyes bzhin du longs spyod par bsams la phung po tshogs mchod btang*/ gsum pa spus ston ni/ nub gsum pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis/ phung po 'dod rgu thams cad 'byung ba'i longs spyod bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ /rkang gling gsum gyis mgron thams cad spyan drangs/ so so'i gang 'dod pa'i yo byad la dgyes bzhin/ rol par bsams la// phung po tshogs mchod ni/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkhyen brtse'i byin rlabs bsam mi khyab// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gror bcas// mchod pa'i tshogs kyis mnyes pa dang*// chos skyong dam can srung ma'i tshogs// thugs dam gnyan po bskang gyur cig /rigs drug 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kun// rang rang 'dod pas tshims gyur cig /lan chags bu lon khyer gyur cig /ces brjod/ gsum pa rjes la gsum/ tshogs drug lam khyer bya ba/ bden pa'i stobs brjod pa/ chos sbyin dang bsngo smon gyis mtha' brgyan pa'o// dang po ni/ /mig gi dbang po'i mtsho nang du// mdzes dang mi mdzes gzugs sogs la// chags shing zhen pa'i 'dre rgod yod// gnas mchog 'di ru gcod cig byed// gsang gcod mtha' ru phyin pa dang*// gzugs 'dzin kha yan 'dre rgod rnams// rang sar zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// rna ba'i dbang po'i brag phug tu// snyan dang mi snyan sgra sogs la// chags shing = /gnas mchog= /gsang gcod= /sgra 'dzin kha yan= /rang sar= /sna yi dbang po'i lam 'phrang du// zhim dang mi zhim dri sogs la// chags shing = /gnas mchog= /gsang gcod= /dri 'dzin kha yan= /rang sar zhi bar= /lce'i dbang po'i thang dkyil (141)du// mngar dang mi mngar ro sogs la// chags shing =

/gnas mchog= /gsang gcod= /ro 'dzin= /rang sar= /lus kyi dbang po'i grong khyer du// 'jam dang mi 'jam reg sogs la// chags shing = /gnas mchog= /gsang gcod= /'jam 'dzin kha yan= /rang sar= /yid kyi dbang po'i mkha' dbyings su// bzang dang ngan pa'i rtog tshogs la= /chags shing zhen pa'i= /gnas mchog 'di= /gsang gcod= /re dogs bzang ngan 'dre rgod rnams// rang sar zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes brjod cing brtul zhugs kyi gdings bskyed/ gnyis pa ni/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten man chad nas// na rag dmyal ba yan chad du// bsam pa tsam gyis tshim gyur cig /dmigs pa tsam gyis grub gyur cig/ ༈ /rgyal ba mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /dam can thugs dam bskang gyur cig /rigs drug 'dod pa tshim gyur= /lan chags bu lon khyer gyur= /pha ma'i drin lan 'khor gyur cig/ ༈ /pha ma la sogs sems can tshogs// rnam bzhi'i mgron du gyur pa la// tshad med mchod sbyin 'di bsngos pas// longs spyod ldan zhing tshogs rdzogs nas// thams cad mngon par sangs rgyas shog/ ༈ /yul phyogs 'di ru byin gyis rlobs// gnas mchog 'di ru= 'dug sa 'di ru= stan thog 'di ru= da lta nyid du= /skad cig nyid du= /myur ba nyid du byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes brjod pas bsdos pa bzhin du grub pa'i mthun 'gyur rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas mdzad par bsam/ gsum pa ni/ /rang nyid skad cig gis 'phags pa thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi par gsal ba'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du hrīḥyig gi mthar yi ge drug ma'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa 'phros// sems can thams cad la phog pas sgo gsum gyi sdig (142)sgrib dag /thugs rje chen po'i sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor gyur bar bsams la/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ /brgya rtsa sogs bzlas pa'i rjes su/ /chos rnams gang dag rgyu las byung*// de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs// rgyu la 'gogs pa gang yin pa// dge sbyong chen pos 'di skad gsungs// sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*// dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/

/ces drang don dang*/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// ngo bo med cing gnas med par// de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la// sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /zhes nges don zab mo'i chos sbyin bya/ /sbyin pa rgya chen gyur pa 'di yi mthus// 'gro ba'i nang nas rang byung sangs rgyas shog /sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis ma bsgral ba'i// skye 'gro'i tshogs rnams sbyin pas grol gyur cig /ces zang zing dang chos sbyin gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo/ phaṭa/ ces pas/ yar mgron rnams chos kyi dbyings su gshegs/ phaṭaḥ mar mgron rnams rang gi gnas su song*/ phaṭa/ rang nyid thugs rje chen po gsal ba'ang 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi dbyings su thim/ slar yang rang skad cig gis thugs rje chen po'i skur gyur par bsam mo// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /thugs rje chen po 'grub gyur cig /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// khyed kyi sa la 'god par shog /pha ma sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig /ngan 'gro thams cad rtag tu stong par shog /byang chub sems dpa' gang dag sar bzhugs pa// de dag kun gyi smon lam 'grub par shog /'jam dpal dpa' bos ji ltar mkhyen pa dang*// kun tu bzang po de yang de bzhin te// de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag slob cing*// (143)dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo// byang chub sems ni rin po che// ma skyes pa rnams skye gyur cig /skyes pa nyams pa med pa dang*// gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang*// 'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod nas// sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs te// rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhag gyur te// sa'am 'on te bar snang 'khod kyang rung*// skye rgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed cing*// nyin dang mtshan mo chos la spyod par shog

/ces sogs bsngo smon bkra shis rgyas par bya// de lta bus mtshon te mnyam rjes thams cad du/ chos thams cad snang stong dbyer med zab gsal zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i rtsis zin par byas pas bdag 'dzin gyi 'khri ba rtsad nas chod de/ bdag med rnam gnyis kyi don la goms 'dris brtan pa thob pa ni rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya'o// gong gi 'gyed dmigs gsum po de gnyan sa sogs su 'gro ba'i tshe nub gsum du rim par bya ba yin la/ rgyun khyer gyi skabs su gsum ka res mos sam thang chags su bya ba'am/ yang na rang gang mos gcig la dril kyang rung bar gsungs so// de ltar kun mkhyen bo dong ba chen po'i zab mo dag snang gi gdams ngag thub pa mdo gcod du grags pa'i ngag 'don bla ma brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes ji lta ba bzhin dag par bris pa dge legs 'phel//(144)
